These original license texts supplement the licenses supplied by the npm packages. The packager includes the applicable texts in the Windows ZIP.

The published `standardwebhooks@1.0.0` JavaScript package declares MIT and omits a license file. Its upstream JavaScript manifest with the same 1.x base64 dependency also declares MIT. The repository provides Apache-2.0 terms. The ZIP records the package's MIT declaration and includes the source repository's full Apache-2.0 text. [Upstream JavaScript manifest](https://github.com/standard-webhooks/standard-webhooks/blob/8ad8586bf2cbea0b2b08fb49ce4b56d42cb870b2/libraries/javascript/package.json)

`pdf-and-zlib.txt` preserves the copyright notices from pdf-lib's FlateStream, SVG path and base64 sources, pako's inflate source, and the original AFM implementation. The PDFKit license comes from the commit referenced in pdf-lib's parser. The base64 and AFM license texts come from the projects credited in the package sources. [PDFKit](https://github.com/foliojs/pdfkit/blob/1e62e6ffe24b378eb890df507a47610f4c4a7b24/LICENSE) · [base64-arraybuffer](https://github.com/niklasvh/base64-arraybuffer/blob/master/LICENSE) · [Christopher Brown’s MIT text](https://chbrown.github.io/licenses/MIT/#2015-2018)
